title: Shermans' direwolf survives a 12-gauge shotgun

tellings.quote: >> Yeah, large direwolf that actually attacked their prized cattle.

plain: In the mid-1990s, the Sherman family, who then owned Skinwalker Ranch in Utah, a ranch known for strange reports, said a huge wolf-like animal attacked their prized cattle and survived being shot with a 12-gauge shotgun. Brandon Fugal, the ranch's current owner, repeats the story, citing a report in the Utah newspaper Deseret News by a reporter named Zack Van Eyk. If it happened, the animal was something no ordinary wolf could be.
